description: Hidden coupling between producer's background naming and compose's slide indexing. producer.sh:24-31 generates backgrounds named slide_1..slide_N by sequential loop index (range(1, n+1)). compose_slides.py:44-45 instead opens the background by the deck-provided field s['n'] (bg_path = slide_<n>.png). These agree ONLY when the deck's 'n' values are exactly the contiguous integers 1..N. A deck with 0-based n, gaps, duplicates, or out-of-order n will mismatch: compose prints 'missing {bg_path}' and skips (compose_slides.py:46-47), ok < N, and producer.sh:49 silently does not queue. Also compose_slides.py:44 'n = s["n"]' KeyErrors (crashes whole deck) if any slide lacks an 'n' key. The contract that 'n' must be contiguous 1..N is implicit and unvalidated.

evidence.snippet: for s in deck["slides"]: n = s["n"]; bg_path = os.path.join(work, f"slide_{n}.png")
